content.title: 2026 Boston Marathon weather forecast is trending cool and dry
content.text: We are about a week away from one of the greatest traditions in the city of Boston, and we’re zeroing in on the forecast. The weather pattern leading up to the 130th Boston Marathon has been very active, in classic spring fashion. At this stage, I’m starting to feel a little optimistic about things, and so should you if you’re running or planning on lining the sidewalks along the 26.2-mile course for the race. Between the European, the AI-Euro, the GFS, and even our in-house weather model that blends those with local observations, there’s pretty good agreement that a frontal system will sweep through the region sometime on Sunday, bringing a round of scattered showers with any raindrops exiting before the sun rises on Monday morning.
